explication: DBM-Warmane is a World of Warcraft 3.3.5a addon that provides encounter timers and warnings across raids, dungeons, world bosses, and events. The principal workflow is game encounter activity reaching encounter-specific modules, which provide DBM’s alerts to the player; the README also documents commands and a configurable options interface. The tree supports these subsystem paths, but no source excerpts were supplied, so internal call ownership and detailed event-to-alert wiring cannot be verified. Voice packs and Bunny’s WeakAuras backport are documented integrations.
